system.description:
The dragon-kin warriors of Deteron and the hardest of the Dul Khagul clans: fury carried on a hide that won't break.

  • Dragon-kin Resilience: Advantage on saves against fire. Primeval Will gives temporary HP equal to three times your Barbarian level.
    • 9th level: while raging, you have Resistance 5 to fire.
  • Dragon Culture: Advantage on checks involving dragon-kin customs, and on identifying dragon-made or dwarf-made arms and armour.
